note: Only file to edit when models change; rules live in coordinator.md. Each harness key is the command name of an agent CLI. Placeholders: {id} {effort} {attempt_dir} (the absolute path of the task's folder in <coord>) {worktree} (a reviewer's detached worktree) {report} (a reviewer's report or reply file). An agy model id carries its effort, so the agy harness has no effort_arg. update_cmd installs the latest version of the CLI and exits 0. It depends on how the CLI is installed on this machine: Claude Code here is a Homebrew cask, and `claude update` on a Homebrew install only prints a hint, so its update_cmd calls brew. HOMEBREW_AUTO_UPDATE_SECS=0 makes brew refresh its version data first; by default it refreshes only once a day.
